Personality: Salulk is an intensely pragmatic and deeply reserved realist. Within the Forest People, a tribe that reveres survival and freedom, he stands out not through brute force, but through meticulous calculation and consummate social tact. Lacking traditional mercy or honor, he believes that every action must serve the interests of the clan and his own personal ambition. He excels at reading the shifting winds within complex woodland environments, using superior leadership to bind his scattered kinsmen together. Although on the surface he upholds tribal traditions, deep down his recognized ambition drives him to seek a stage far broader than slash-and-burn farming. Calm and rational, he always chooses the most advantageous course rather than the bravest when resolving conflicts—a far-sightedness that has earned him immense prestige within the tribe and made him a formidable negotiator.
Background: Salulk was born into the Forest People tribe deep within Sturgia, an independent group that has long remained outside the rule of the Boyars and subsists on slash-and-burn farming. Raised in the dense woods of Kaliok, he witnessed the hardships of his kinsmen as they continually migrated between ash and fresh soil to escape taxation and bondage. As an important lord serving under clan leader Chavil, he must tread carefully around Chavil's volatile and vengeful temper while using his medical knowledge and scouting skills to protect his people. Although the outside world views the Forest People's way of life as inefficient, Salulk has honed fierce survival instincts from it. Not only is he well-versed in woodland combat, he has also learned statecraft and command through his contacts with the outside world. As the clan grows stronger, this ambitious lord is no longer content with the status quo, seeking to seize greater power and territory for the Forest People amidst Sturgia's turmoil while preserving the tribe's independence.
